body:
Sabrina James: anyone else seeing *zero traces* in local dev for the quickstart templates? running `docker compose up` brings up the collector but app says it exported. collector logs show nothing incoming.

Sabrina James: env:
```bash
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf
OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=rag-agent-template
```
I hit the app endpoint a bunch, still nothing.

Caleb Johnson: are you running the app on host (python uvicorn/node) or inside docker?

Sabrina James: app on host (macOS), collector in docker via compose.

Caleb Johnson: ok. when app is on host, `localhost:4318` should work (collector port published). can you paste compose and collector logs? also make sure you’re exporting OTLP HTTP to `4318` not gRPC `4317`.

Sabrina James: compose snippet (from template):
```yaml
services:
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.95.0
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"]
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"
      - "4318:4318"
      - "8889:8889"
    volumes:
      - ./otel-collector-config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml
```
collector logs:
```text
otel-collector  | 2025-02-28T18:54:11.203Z\tinfo\tservice@v0.95.0/service.go:143\tStarting otelcol...\n
otel-collector  | 2025-02-28T18:54:11.206Z\tinfo\treceivers/otlp.go:112\tStarting HTTP server\t{"endpoint": "0.0.0.0:4318"}\n
otel-collector  | 2025-02-28T18:54:11.207Z\tinfo\treceivers/otlp.go:96\tStarting gRPC server\t{"endpoint": "0.0.0.0:4317"}\n```
then… nothing.

Dana Lo: what SDK are you using? python or TS? and are we sure spans are being created?

Sabrina James: python template. seeing logs like:
```text
INFO telemetry: exporting span batch size=32
```
so it thinks it’s exporting.

Allison Grant: couple things to check:
1) if you set `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, some libs expect the *base* and auto-append `/v1/traces` for http/protobuf, others expect the full path.
2) ensure `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp` isn’t overridden.
3) if you’re using the python OTLP HTTP exporter directly, it usually wants `http://localhost:4318/v1/traces`.

Caleb Johnson: +1. easiest: try setting endpoint to include the path explicitly and see if collector starts logging requests.

Sabrina James: updating to:
```bash
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318/v1/traces
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf
```
restarting app.

Sahana Iyer: also worth checking you don’t have `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT` set somewhere (it overrides the generic endpoint in a few SDKs). `env | grep OTEL_EXPORTER` maybe.

Sabrina James: good catch, I had this from another project:
```bash
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4317
```
(and protocol still http/protobuf :facepalm:)

Caleb Johnson: that would do it. `4317` is gRPC. either switch protocol to grpc OR set traces endpoint to 4318.

Monica Patel: we should probably add a note in the README + `doctor` command: detect mismatch like `*_TRACES_ENDPOINT` using 4317 while protocol is http/protobuf.

Sabrina James: cleared the `*_TRACES_ENDPOINT` and set:
```bash
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf
```
now collector shows:
```text
otel-collector  | 2025-02-28T19:07:40.912Z\tinfo\tTracesExporter\tExporting 16 spans\n```
:thumbsup:

Priya Shah: nice. can you drop the “symptoms + fix” summary? this is probably going to be a common support reply.

Sabrina James: summary:
- symptom: app logs claim it’s exporting, collector shows only startup, no incoming spans
- root cause: had `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4317` set from another project (gRPC port), while protocol was `http/protobuf`
- fix: unset `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT` OR set it to `http://localhost:4318` (HTTP OTLP), keep protocol consistent.

Sergio Costa: another gotcha I’ve seen: if app runs *in docker* and collector in docker, `localhost` inside the container points to itself. then you need `http://otel-collector:4318` (service name) not `http://localhost:4318`. but Sabrina’s case was host->docker so `localhost` was fine.

Allison Grant: +1 and one more: if you use HTTP exporter and set `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318`, some SDKs require `/v1/traces`. Recommended env pattern we should document:
```bash
# generic
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318/v1/traces
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318/v1/metrics
```
(avoids ambiguity)

Monica Patel: I’ll add this to the template troubleshooting page + open a follow-up for CLI doctor to flag protocol/port mismatch. @Sahana Iyer can you help with the doctor check?

Sahana Iyer: yup, I’ll add a rule:
- if endpoint contains `:4317` and protocol contains `http` -> warn + suggest grpc or 4318
- if endpoint is `:4318` and protocol is `grpc` -> warn
also print whether `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT` is set (since it silently overrides)

Caleb Johnson: last thing: collector metrics endpoint is 8889 right? if someone wants to sanity check collector is alive:
```bash
curl -s localhost:8889/metrics | head
```
if that works but you see no spans, it’s exporter config not collector.

Sabrina James: confirmed `curl localhost:8889/metrics` works. with fixed env, traces are flowing. thanks all.
